summary: FTAI Infrastructure Inc. disclosed via an 8-K that its indirect subsidiary Jefferson 2020 Bond Borrower LLC entered into a $230M secured bridge loan facility with lenders and Jefferies Finance LLC as administrative agent. Proceeds repaid outstanding Port of Beaumont bonds, funded a debt service reserve, and paid fees. Interest is Term SOFR plus 5.50% with step-ups every 90 days, maturing June 30, 2027. The filing constitutes a routine financing agreement under Item 1.01, not a special situation, as it involves no acquisition, divestiture, or shareholder impact beyond standard credit terms.
